julia (eng-platform): quick check — if we move to a gRPC-first internal surface, how do we expose per-route quotas and routing policies in the console? we need visibility for ratebox billing and canary rules.
omar (eng): +1 on wanting grpc-first, but quotas are annoying. do we map routes 1:1 to rpc methods or group them under logical routes in the gateway?
kai (eng-infra): we did a spike where envoy translated method names into a route tag. simple approach: proto service.method -> route. downside: noisy metric cardinality.
maria (product): cardinality kills dashboards. product teams need neat per-feature breakdowns, not a million method-level rows. can we attach a higher-level "feature" label in the gateway?
omar (eng): yeah add a header like x-feature-id at ingress. gateway adds it via routing rules. then quotas and dashboards can use that label. would need SDK + codegen to ensure callers set it, or we inject via edge mapping.
julia (eng-platform): injecting at the gateway is appealing (less client work) but then we lose exact rpc-level telemetry for debugging. maybe we keep both: feature label plus method label (but sample method-level telemetry to control cardinality).
kai (eng-infra): we can do sampled method telemetry: every n requests or error-only. for quotas we need deterministic enforcement though. quotas should be enforced on the feature label boundary (business quota) and optionally on method for safety.
maria (product): matte point — business teams buy capacity by feature, not by rpc. expose a clear cost-per-feature metric in the console. users should be able to drill down to methods when needed.
omar (eng): operationally: implementing hierarchical quotas in the control plane is extra work. options: 1) feature-only quotas in our quota service; 2) feature + per-method soft limits (alerts only); 3) per-method strict quotas (explode billing complexity).
julia (eng-platform): preferences? i'm leaning to option 2 initially. feature strict for billing, method soft for ops. keeps complexity bounded.
kai (eng-infra): agree. we can annotate route mapping in the registry proto like:
```proto
message RouteMeta {
  string feature = 1;
  bool method_enforce = 2; // opt-in
}
```
And let the gateway attach x-feature and x-method-enforce header.
maria (product): that proto sounds good. UX ask: in console, quota page should show feature usage, remaining, projected burn, and a quick toggle to see method-level heatmap (sampled). also surface canary routing rules that might shift traffic between model variants.
omar (eng): about routing policies — grpc streams complicate things. we need stream-aware routing (sticky to pool) vs unary. gateway must mark stream affinity in routing table. dashboards should show stream-level SLOs separately.
julia (eng-platform): telemetry question: do we push method/feature metrics as prometheus labels? label explosion concern again. maybe feature label is cardinality-safe; method label only on aggregated counters with hashed buckets.
kai (eng-infra): hashing methods into N buckets works for heatmaps and keeps label cardinality. we lose exact method names but can do on-demand full traces through sampling.
maria (product): make sure the console's drilldown links to traces and request-level logs when sampled. product teams love click-to-trace.
omar (eng): rollout UX: when we introduce a new gateway mapping, teams should be able to preview the mapping in console and run a canary that only changes the feature label mapping for a subset of traffic. suggestion: preview tab + dry-run toggle.
ulia_typo (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: new mapping created by @julia: mapping-id=map-2026-07-01-9. dry-run=false
julia (eng-platform): haha typo bot message, but deploy-bot note is useful — we should have mapping audit entries surfaced.
kai (eng-infra): security note: if gateway injects x-feature, we must sign/internally validate it to avoid spoofing from internal clients. ideally the gateway rewrites any client-provided value.
omar (eng): agreed. gateway-only authoritative. sdk should still include a hint header for convenience but gateway overwrites.
maria (product): ok next steps: (1) implement RouteMeta proto & registry mapping (kai + omar), (2) console: feature quota page + sampled method heatmap (maria + julia), (3) quota control plane: feature strict + method soft alerting (kai).
julia (eng-platform): timeline? can we have a spike in 2 weeks for the proto/gateway and a console mock next week for PM signoff?
kai (eng-infra): spike onboarded — i'll provision a test gateway and wire the registry. target: spike complete in 12 business days.
omar (eng): i'll do the minimal SDK hinting & the method-sample telemetry hook.
maria (product): i'll ship a console mock by EOD Thu and collect feedback.
julia (eng-platform): perfect. tagging folks: @kai @omar @maria. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
omar (eng): minor follow-up — how do we handle third-party services that only support JSON/unary? gateway should translate and still set feature label via a mapping table.
kai (eng-infra): translator layer will map http -> grpc method then feature. that's part of the spike.
julia (eng-platform): ok closing this thread, will create an RFC with the options and the spike plan. if anyone has objections, shout now.
maria (product): no objections. excited to see the console mock.
julia (eng-platform): thanks all.
